run_a_node.title: Run a Morphit node
run_a_node.subtitle: Operate your own instance. Earn a share of listing fees. Help make Morphit uncensorable.
run_a_node.why_uncensor_body: Every additional node makes the network harder to censor. If your country blocks morphit.io, your instance stays reachable. You serve users who'd otherwise have no way to trade.
run_a_node.why_community_body: Brand the interface for your region, your language, your local payment methods. Users trust frontends that speak their language and feel familiar — yours will.
run_a_node.why_privacy_body: Users trading through your instance share metadata with you and only you. No other operator, not even Agorise, sees their activity patterns.
run_a_node.why_earn_body:
Every BLURT-paid listing fee your instance attracts pays you 90% — only 10% goes to the Morphit treasury to fund the furthering development and maintenance of the Morphit software itself. BTC- and XMR-paid fees flow 100% to the treasury for the same project obligations (the on-chain split mechanism only works for BLURT, but we made the BLURT split aggressively generous to compensate — 90/10 in your favor).

A Smart Contract running on the blockchain enforces the split — not a person, not a company, not anyone who can change their mind. 100% automated. You provably assist, you provably get paid. Guaranteed in code.

Payouts are denominated in BLURT, so if BLURT appreciates, so do your earnings — without any additional work on your part.
run_a_node.step1_body: Linux (Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Arch, NixOS — we test on Debian). 2 CPU cores at 1 GHz+, 2 GB RAM minimum (4 GB comfortable), 20 GB SSD. A Raspberry Pi 4, an old laptop, or a $5/month VPS all work. No static IP needed — DDNS works fine. See the FAQ entry on minimum hardware requirements for the full breakdown across hobbyist, serious, and spare-laptop tiers.
run_a_node.step2_body: Fork or clone git.agorise.net/agorise/morphit. Copy env examples from ops/env/, set your domain, set the indexer's RPC endpoints (Blurt public nodes work out of the box).
run_a_node.step3_body: systemd units for the indexer and relay are in ops/systemd/. nginx config with TLS is in ops/nginx/. Run the migration tool once to initialize the database schema.
run_a_node.step4_body: Run the register-operator CLI tool with your chosen tag (1-64 chars, alphanumeric + dashes/underscores/dots). Tags are first-come-first-served — once you broadcast the one-time `morphit_register_operator` op, that tag is yours. Your instance appears in /operators and begins attributing orders (and earning your 90% share of BLURT-paid listing fees) immediately. See the operator-earnings FAQ for the full economics.
run_a_node.asset_policy_body: Morphit's federation lets each operator pick which tradable assets their instance accepts new orders for. New assets ship default-ON instance-wide — operators opt out per-asset via the `MORPHIT_INDEXER_DISABLED_ASSETS` environment variable. This is how a federation of instances can serve different user preferences without anyone needing to fork the code.
run_a_node.asset_policy_default_body: When the project adds a new tradable asset (USDT shipped most recently), every instance accepts orders for it the moment they upgrade. No code change, no per-asset enablement step.
run_a_node.asset_policy_opt_out_body: Operators who prefer their instance specializes in privacy-first or decentralization-first assets can disable any trade-only asset with `MORPHIT_INDEXER_DISABLED_ASSETS="USDT"` (or a comma-separated list for multiple). Users posting through this operator's frontend then can't pick a disabled asset.
run_a_node.asset_policy_federation_body: Disabling an asset on your instance doesn't hide peer instances' orders from your users — chain history is shared, so the orderbook still surfaces them as read-only. The gate is only on NEW orders posted FROM your instance.

security.heading: Security posture
security.subtitle: What we promise, and what that means for you.
security.keys_title: Your keys never leave your device.
security.keys_body: Keys are generated in your browser using libsodium. They are encrypted with a password you choose (Argon2id + XSalsa20-Poly1305) before being stored. No Morphit server ever sees them.
security.tracking_body: No cookies. No analytics. No third-party scripts. No IP logging. No telemetry. If you look at the Network tab in your browser, every request goes to Morphit and nowhere else.
security.chat_body: Every message uses X25519 key agreement plus ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption (libsodium primitives) with a fresh ephemeral key per message. Plaintext exists only inside your browser and your trading partner's browser. Morphit's servers, the underlying chain, and anyone in between see only ciphertext. The full protocol — including the deliberate tradeoffs we accept (no per-message forward secrecy) — is in {chat_crypto_doc}.
security.reproducible_body: Every release is tagged; every asset is fingerprinted; SRI protects every script. You can rebuild from source and compare — we publish the hashes alongside each release.
security.open_source_body: The full threat model is in the repo's {security_doc}. We're explicit about what we protect against and what we don't — because pretending otherwise would be worse than honesty.
security.footer_body: Found an issue? Please report via the public Forgejo repo, or via an encrypted message to the {morphit_account} chain account.
security.bounty_body: We run a discretionary security recognition program. Every actionable finding gets reviewed by a real engineer, gets an answer, and — if it materially improves Morphit's security posture — gets rewarded in BLURT (paid from @morphit-fees) or BTC, scaled to severity and the report's quality. No fixed tier table; case-by-case adjudication. Hall of fame credit available even when payment isn't. The full scope, severity guidance, payment workflow, and what we won't do (no NDA, no exclusive disclosure) is documented in SECURITY.md.
security.bounty_link: Read the full bounty program scope and rules
security.canary_body: We publish a weekly warrant canary signed with the operator's PGP key. The canary explicitly declares no NSL / FISA / gag-order / backdoor demand has been served. Freshness proofs include a current blockchain head, a current Bitcoin chain head, and a current news headline (proves the canary cannot be pre-generated). If the canary stops updating for more than 14 days, treat it as silent: the operator may be under coercive pressure, and you should switch to a different federated operator.

session.heading: Utility
session.explain: Sign out when you're done. Your keys will be wiped from memory; the encrypted keystore on your device is untouched.
session.autolock_help: Automatically lock your session after this long with no activity. Locking clears your keys from memory; your encrypted keystore stays on this device so you can unlock with your password when you return.

change_password.heading: Change password
change_password.help: Replace your keystore password without signing out. Your keys stay the same; only the password that decrypts them changes.
change_password.strength_common: This password is too common. Pick something less guessable.
change_password.strength_trivial: This password is too simple. Try a longer mix of words.
change_password.strength_short: Consider a longer password — 12+ characters is much harder to guess.

err.new_password_too_short: New password must be at least 8 characters.
err.same_password: New password must be different from your current password.
err.locked: Your session is locked. Unlock first, then try again.
err.bad_old_password: That doesn't match your current password. Try again.
err.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
err.internal: Something went wrong. Your old password still works; please try again.

nostr_url.heading: Nostr link
nostr_url.explain: Optional. Add your Nostr profile URL and a small Nostr icon appears next to your username everywhere on Morphit. Helps people reach you outside this marketplace.
nostr_url.label: Your Nostr URL
nostr_url.hint_empty: Leave blank if you do not want a Nostr link shown.

error.too_long: Too long. Keep it under 512 characters.
error.invalid_scheme: Only nostr:, https://, and http:// URLs are allowed.
error.malformed: That does not look like a valid URL.

nostr_url.reminder_body: Once published, the Nostr icon appears next to your username on every order, every feedback entry, every chat message — on every Morphit instance, not just this one. Other users tap it to open your Nostr profile in their preferred client.

blurt_media_url.heading: Blurt.media profile URL
blurt_media_url.explain: A link to your profile on blurt.media, a popular Blurt frontend for streaming. Displayed alongside your username everywhere on Morphit. Optional.
blurt_media_url.label: Blurt.media URL
blurt_media_url.hint_empty: Paste your blurt.media profile URL here, or leave blank.

error.wrong_host: Only blurt.media URLs are accepted here.

blurt_media_url.reminder_body: Your Morphit identity works fine without this URL. It's a courtesy link for people who might want to also see your videos or podcasts.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.explain: Morphit pings you when something happens — an order fills, a chat message arrives, feedback lands. All of these are off-by-default where annoying-by-default, and opt-in where high-signal. Never when you're already looking at the page.
notifications.category_heading: What do you want to be told about?
notifications.category_order_help: Your order filled, expired, or was replaced by a counter-offer. Recommended on — highest signal-to-noise.
notifications.category_chat_help: New message in an active trade chat. Coalesced: 3 messages in 30 seconds is one notification.
notifications.category_feedback_help: Someone left you feedback, or responded to feedback you left them.
notifications.channel_ambient_help: Always on. Zero permissions, never audible. Works on the tab you're looking at.
notifications.channel_native_help: OS-native notification when a new event arrives and this tab isn't focused. Asks permission the first time we need it.
notifications.channel_push_help: Also notify when Morphit is not open at all. Requires a push service — you can choose self-hosted, standard browser, or off.
notifications.channel_audio_help: Short sound when a notification fires. Only plays when this tab isn't focused.
notifications.channel_vibrate_help: Short vibration pattern when a notification fires. Ignored on devices that don't support it.
notifications.quiet_explain: Silence audio and push during these hours. Visual channels (title bar, favicon, badge) still update — they're ambient, not alerts.
notifications.mute_until_unmute: Mute until I turn it back on
notifications.permission_banner_body: You just got a new {category} event. Want to know about future ones even when you're not looking at Morphit?
notifications.permission_denied_explain: You previously declined notifications. If you'd like to enable them, you'll need to change your browser's site permission for this page, then toggle the setting above.
notifications.hint_badging_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support OS-level app badges. Install Morphit as an app to enable this.
notifications.hint_notifications_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support desktop notifications.
notifications.push_error_push_disabled: This instance's operator has not enabled push delivery yet. Falling back to in-tab notifications.
notifications.push_error_permission_denied: You declined the browser's notification permission. To enable push later, allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
notifications.push_error_not_supported: Your browser does not support Web Push. Try a recent Firefox, Chrome, or Edge.
notifications.push_error_unreachable: Could not reach the operator's relay. Check your connection and try again.
notifications.push_error_no_vapid_key: The operator's relay did not return a push key. Push may be temporarily disabled.
notifications.push_error_subscribe_failed: Subscription failed. Try again, or check your browser's site permissions.
notifications.push_error_internal: Something went wrong on the operator's relay. Try again in a moment.
notifications.push_error_signature_required: This instance requires a signed subscribe request. Make sure your account is unlocked and try again.
notifications.push_error_signature_invalid: Your signature was rejected by the relay. Try unlocking your account again, then retry.
notifications.push_error_locked_session: Your session is locked. Unlock your account first to enable push notifications.
notifications.push_error_push_service_unavailable: Your browser blocked web push — usually a privacy feature like Brave's Shields, uBlock Origin, or another ad/tracker blocker (web push relies on Google's servers, which they block). Lower your browser's shields for this site to allow it, or leave push off — the notification options above still work. Push only matters when Morphit is fully closed.

hidden_accounts.heading: Hidden accounts
hidden_accounts.explain: Orders from these accounts don't appear on your orderbook view. You can unhide anyone at any time.
hidden_accounts.scope_note: Hiding is local to this browser. It doesn't ban anyone from the protocol, doesn't notify them, and doesn't affect what other Morphit instances see.
hidden_accounts.unhide_all_confirm: Unhide all {count} accounts? This will make their orders visible again on your orderbook view.

avatar.heading: Avatar
avatar.explain: Replace your default heart identicon with your own image.
avatar.guidance_filetypes: Accepts SVG, WebP, JPEG, PNG, or GIF.
avatar.guidance_dimensions: Ideal source: a square image at least 96×96 pixels. Anything larger will be resized down to 96×96 for you; anything smaller will look grainy.
avatar.guidance_filesize: Source file size: up to 5 MB. Larger images will be downsampled to 96×96 automatically, so even a phone photo straight from your camera works fine.
avatar.guidance_size: Raster images are automatically re-encoded to WebP at high quality. SVGs are minified losslessly. The final payload must fit under 6 KB.
avatar.guidance_svg_tips: SVG tip: a square viewBox (e.g. 0 0 100 100) renders best. Scripts, external references, and HTML-in-SVG are stripped automatically for security.
avatar.permanence_body: Once broadcast, your avatar is public on the blockchain forever. It cannot be deleted, only replaced. Never upload an image you wouldn't want publicly associated with your account for the rest of time — photos of faces, in particular, are a privacy consideration given modern face-recognition tools.
avatar.preview_getting_large: Getting close to the size limit — consider a simpler image or smaller source.

error.unsupported_type: That file type isn't supported. Use SVG, WebP, JPEG, PNG, or GIF.
error.input_too_large: That image is too large to upload. Please choose a file under 5 MB.
error.parse_failed: Couldn't parse this SVG. The file may be malformed.
error.svg_no_root: That doesn't look like a valid SVG file.
error.svg_too_large: This SVG is too complex to fit under the 6 KB on-chain limit. Try simplifying it — fewer paths, less detail, or a smaller viewBox.
error.raster_too_large: Even after resizing and re-encoding, this image is too large for on-chain storage. Try a simpler or less-detailed source image.
error.raster_decode_failed: Couldn't decode this image. The file may be corrupt or an unsupported format variant.

error.webp_unavailable: Your browser doesn't support WebP output. Try a different browser.
error.processing_failed: Couldn't process this image. Try a different file.

avatar.remove_confirm_body: This broadcasts a profile update that clears your avatar on-chain. You can upload a new one anytime.

blocked_accounts.heading: Blocked accounts
blocked_accounts.explain: Accounts you have blocked cannot send you chat messages on Morphit. Blocking is on-chain and visible to anyone scraping Blurt, but Morphit does not tell the blocked person.
blocked_accounts.scope_note: This list is derived from on-chain blocks. Refresh to pull the latest from the indexer.
blocked_accounts.refresh_aria: Refresh the blocked accounts list from the indexer
blocked_accounts.unblock_failed: Could not unblock. Please check your connection and try again.
blocked_accounts.locked_hint: Unlock your session to unblock accounts.

syndication.heading: Syndication
syndication.explain: Morphit can publish announcement posts to your Blurt blog when you take certain actions. These are signed by your posting key.
syndication.first_trade_label: Announce my first trade to the @morphit community
syndication.first_trade_help: When you leave feedback for your first-ever Morphit trade, also publish a short "I joined Morphit" post to the @morphit community on Blurt. Posts only once per account, ever. Per-order syndication is a separate per-submission checkbox on the order form.
syndication.pitch_body: Syndication of your trades is everything. More eyes on your offers means more trading partners, plus upvote rewards going directly into your Blurt Wallet. Off = nothing public.
syndication.blog_default_explain: You've made your first trade — nice. Morphit can now pre-tick the "post this order to my Blurt blog" box on every new order, so your offers get shared automatically. Each post is still signed by you, and you can untick it on any individual order.
syndication.blog_default_label: Post my orders to my Blurt blog by default
syndication.blog_default_help: Pre-ticks the per-order "syndicate to my blog" checkbox on the order form. You can always untick it for a specific order. Off = the box starts unticked each time.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.cross_page_trade_events_help: When on, Morphit watches your recent chats for trade events (address shared, funds sent) so badges update on /my/orders without you opening the chat. This briefly decrypts incoming messages in the background. Turn off if you prefer the chat page itself to be the only place trade events are processed.
privacy.address_history_help: Crypto addresses you share in chat are remembered on this device so Morphit can warn you if you reuse one. They stay in this browser only and are never sent to any server.
privacy.address_history_empty: No addresses remembered on this device yet.
privacy.address_history_forget_confirm: Forget all {count} remembered addresses? This clears them from this browser only and can't be undone.

hardware_key.heading: Hardware key
hardware_key.explain: Bind a YubiKey to your keystore as a second unlock method, or as your only unlock method. Adds a strong second factor that a stolen password alone can't bypass.
hardware_key.unsupported_title: Your browser doesn't support hardware keys
hardware_key.unsupported_body: YubiKey unlock requires WebHID, which is currently only available in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and other Chromium-based browsers. Firefox and Safari don't expose this API. You can keep using your password as before.
hardware_key.seed_only_note: Hardware keys are only available when you have a persisted keystore. You're using seed-only mode — no envelope is stored on this device, so there's nothing to bind a key to.
hardware_key.soften_explain: After this, you'll be able to unlock with EITHER your YubiKey OR a password. Set a new password below; you'll need your YubiKey one more time to apply the change.
hardware_key.backup_warning_title: Have you backed up your seed phrase and your keys?
hardware_key.backup_warning_body: Adding a YubiKey re-encrypts your keystore. If you lose access to your YubiKey AND forget your password, only your 12-word seed phrase can recover this account. Please make sure it's written down somewhere safe before continuing.
hardware_key.backup_confirm_label: Yes, my seed phrase is backed up safely.
hardware_key.slot_hint: Most users program HMAC-SHA1 challenge-response into slot 2 — slot 1 usually holds Yubico OTP. Use Yubico Authenticator to configure your key first if you haven't already.
hardware_key.harden_warning_title: This is a one-way switch — proceed with care.
hardware_key.harden_warning_body: After hardening, your password will no longer unlock this keystore. Only your YubiKey will. If you lose your YubiKey, only your 12-word seed phrase can recover this account. You can always soften back later, but it requires a YubiKey tap.
hardware_key.harden_confirm_label: I understand. Without my YubiKey or seed phrase, this account is permanently inaccessible.

phase.requesting: Choose your YubiKey from the browser prompt…

error.enroll_verify_failed: We couldn't verify your YubiKey. Make sure slot 2 is set up for HMAC-SHA1 challenge-response, try a different USB port, then enroll again.
error.confirm_backup: Please confirm your seed phrase is backed up before continuing.
error.webhid_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support WebHID. Try Chrome, Edge, or Brave.

error.timeout: YubiKey timed out. Tap your key promptly when it lights up.
error.persist_failed: Couldn't save the change to this device. Storage may be unavailable (private mode, quota, or disabled). The change has not been applied.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and if the problem persists, restart the page.
error.label_too_long: The label you entered is too long.
error.wrap_limit_reached: This keystore already has the maximum number of YubiKey wraps. Remove one before adding another.
error.duplicate_yubikey_label: This keystore already has a YubiKey enrolled. Remove the existing one first to add a different YubiKey.
error.not_layered: This keystore isn't ready for hardware-key operations. Enroll a YubiKey first.
error.no_yubikey_wrap: This keystore has no YubiKey enrolled.
error.wrap_index_out_of_range: That YubiKey wrap couldn't be found. Reload the page and try again.
error.cannot_unenroll_last_wrap: Removing this would leave your keystore unrecoverable. Add another unlock method first.

error.unwrap_failed: Couldn't decrypt the keystore with this YubiKey. Make sure you tapped the correct key, or try a different one if you've enrolled multiple.

install.heading: Install Morphit as an app
install.explain: Add Morphit to your home screen for one-tap access. The app launches in fullscreen, works offline, and gets the same updates as the website. No data leaves your device that wouldn't already.
install.manual_intro: Your browser doesn't expose a one-click install. Use the manual path:
install.manual_chrome: Chrome / Edge: tap the address bar's install icon, or use the browser menu → Install Morphit.
install.manual_safari: Safari (macOS / iOS): tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.manual_firefox: Firefox Android: tap the menu (︙), then "Install". Firefox desktop doesn't support PWA install — use Chromium-based browsers.

account_name.heading: account name
account_name.explain: Morphit needs to know your account name so it can recognize your trades, messages, and on-chain activity. If you imported a posting key with the account name, this is already set. If you imported a seed phrase or keyfile, set it here.
account_name.locked_explain: To change this, sign out, then re-import with a different account.
account_name.input_hint: Without the @. We'll verify your posting key matches this account on the blockchain before saving.
account_name.error_locked: Unlock your keystore first to set your account name.
account_name.error_bad_format: Account names use lowercase letters, digits, dashes, and dots — 3 to 16 characters, starting with a letter.
account_name.error_not_found: We couldn't find @{account} on the blockchain. Check the spelling.
account_name.error_key_mismatch: Your posting key doesn't match @{account}'s posting authority. Check that you imported the right keys.
account_name.error_chain_unreachable: We couldn't reach the blockchain. Check your connection and try again.
account_name.no_account_link: Don't have an account yet? Claim a name

import_landing_banner.title: Almost done — pick your @account so the orderbook recognizes you
import_landing_banner.body: We brought you here because seed/keyfile imports don't carry your account name. Set it once below and we'll verify it on-chain.

preferences.heading: Preferences
preferences.explain: Morphit remembers a few of your form values so you don't have to refill them every time you post. Stored only on this device — never sent to any server, never put on chain.
preferences.empty: No preferences saved yet. Post an order and your fiat currency and region will be remembered for next time.
preferences.clear_confirm_body: Clear your saved fiat currency and region? You'll just need to pick them again next time you post.

totp.heading: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
totp.subtitle: Add an authenticator app as a second factor after your password. Protects against shoulder-surfing, borrowed devices, and casual local malware.

honest_framing.title: What this protects against — honestly
honest_framing.protects_intro: TOTP-based 2FA is a meaningful second gate after your password. It stops:
honest_framing.protects_shoulder_surf: Someone watching you type your password
honest_framing.protects_borrowed: A friend who watched you log in once trying again on your laptop
honest_framing.protects_malware: Casual local malware that grabs your keystore but doesn’t know to extract the TOTP secret
honest_framing.limits_intro: It does NOT add cryptographic strength against:
honest_framing.limits_offline: A determined attacker who has stolen your encrypted keystore AND cracked your password — the TOTP secret lives in the same encrypted blob as the keys.
honest_framing.limits_path_forward: For real cryptographic 2FA where the second factor’s secret never lives on the protected device, the path forward is FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware keys. Morphit has exploratory support; it’s not production-ready yet.

status.backup_codes_remaining: {count, plural, one {# backup code remaining} other {# backup codes remaining}}
status.backup_codes_low: You’re running low on backup codes. Regenerate a new set and put them somewhere safe.
status.backup_codes_exhausted: You have no backup codes left. If you lose your authenticator, you’ll need your seed phrase to recover.

enroll.step1_body: We strongly recommend the open-source options below. Morphit does NOT recommend Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy — closed source, with backup/sync paths that can leak your secrets.
enroll.step2_body: Open your authenticator and scan this code. If you can’t scan (no camera, accessibility), enter the secret manually below.
enroll.step3_title: 3. Confirm the code from your app
enroll.step3_body: Type the 6-digit code your authenticator currently shows. The code rotates every 30 seconds; if yours just changed, wait for the next one.
enroll.step4_body: These ten codes will let you log in if you lose your authenticator. Each code works exactly ONCE. Save them somewhere safe — a password manager, printed and locked away, or written on paper. We will not show them again.
enroll.backup_acknowledge: I have saved these backup codes somewhere safe.
enroll.err_invalid_code: That code didn’t verify. Check your device time is in sync and try again.
enroll.err_internal: Something went wrong. Your keystore is unchanged; please try again.
enroll.err_locked: Your session is locked. Unlock first, then try again.

unenroll.confirm_body: You’ll be able to unlock with just your password. Are you sure?
unenroll.err_invalid_code: That code didn’t verify. Try again.

regenerate.confirm_body: Your previous backup codes will stop working immediately. Make sure you can complete the new-codes save step before continuing.
regenerate.err_invalid_code: That code didn’t verify. Try again.

unlock_prompt.body: Your password worked. Now enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
unlock_prompt.err_invalid_code: That code didn’t verify. Check your device time is in sync, or try a backup code.
unlock_prompt.err_locked_out: Too many invalid attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

aegis.tagline: Encrypted local backups, biometric lock, no cloud sync. Android only.

2fas.tagline: iOS + Android. Optional encrypted cloud backup is OPT-IN, not the default.

ente.tagline: End-to-end-encrypted cross-device sync (iOS + Android + Linux + Mac + Windows + Web).

not_recommended_apps.heading: Apps we don’t recommend (and why)
not_recommended_apps.expand: See which apps we suggest avoiding

google_authenticator.name: Google Authenticator
google_authenticator.reason: Closed source. Cloud backup syncs secrets to Google by default (opt-OUT, not opt-IN) and these secrets are not end-to-end encrypted to your account password.

authy.name: Authy
authy.reason: Closed source. Cloud-only backups with a history of account-recovery exploits (SIM-swap vectors). Desktop app deprecated 2024.

lost_device.heading: What if I lose my authenticator?
lost_device.body: Use one of your 10 backup codes at unlock. Each works once. If you lose your authenticator AND all backup codes, you’ll need your 12-word seed phrase to recover — there’s no admin who can help, because Morphit doesn’t hold your keys.

totp.yubikey_protected: This keystore is protected with a YubiKey. Adding TOTP-based 2FA to a YubiKey-protected keystore isn’t supported in this version. Your YubiKey already provides cryptographically stronger authentication than TOTP would.

shipment_modal.heading: Record a shipment
shipment_modal.intro: Share your carrier + tracking number so your trade partner can verify the shipment.
shipment_modal.safety_heading: Safety tips for any physical shipment
shipment_modal.safety_insurance: Use a tracked, INSURED service. If the package is lost or stolen, insurance is your only recourse.
shipment_modal.safety_plain_envelope: Use a plain envelope or box with no markings suggesting valuables inside.
shipment_modal.safety_return_address: Return address tradeoff: omitting it preserves anonymity but means undeliverable mail gets destroyed.
shipment_modal.safety_tracking_optional: Tracking number is optional but strongly recommended as proof of shipment.
shipment_modal.cash_tips_toggle: If you're mailing CASH, read this first
shipment_modal.cash_tinfoil: Wrap the cash in aluminum foil inside the envelope — defeats people holding envelopes to bright light to see contents.
shipment_modal.cash_ups_fedex_prohibit: UPS and FedEx PROHIBIT cash shipments in their terms of service. If opened, they can confiscate with no recourse. Use a postal service instead.
shipment_modal.cash_customs: International: do not lie on customs declarations. High-value cash will be seized regardless.
shipment_modal.custom_tracking_url_help: Full https:// URL where the recipient can look up the tracking number.
shipment_modal.tracking_help: As provided by the carrier. Letters, numbers, spaces, dashes are accepted.

welcome_first_buy.heading: Your first trade is on us. 🌱
welcome_first_buy.lead: Welcome to Morphit! Your first order is a free buy of BLURT — we cover the listing fee, and you walk away with a real starter balance in your wallet. Here's why this is one of the best onboarding deals in P2P crypto:
welcome_first_buy.bullet_free: The listing fee is free. Morphit pays the network fee for your first trade — your only cost is whatever you agree to pay your counterparty.
welcome_first_buy.bullet_starter: You walk away with actual funds in your on-chain wallet for the trading fees (at the discounted rate too (~12.5¢ each)) from day one.
welcome_first_buy.bullet_runway: BLURT works across the entire Blurt social network. Use it to vote on posts at blurt.blog, blurt.media, etc and earn rewards just by clicking "Like" on good content.
welcome_first_buy.bullet_bp_stake: You unlock 1 BP welcome stake instantly the moment your first BLURT-paid listing fee fires. After your first successful trade, that becomes 10 BLURT liquid + 10 BLURT Power — a passive-income producing stake on the network.
welcome_first_buy.why_blurt_minimum: Why BLURT and not BTC or XMR for the free trade? Because the BLURT in your wallet is what lets you do everything else on Morphit afterward — pay listing fees on future trades (at half price!), participate in the Blurt social layer, and earn loyalty rewards. We want you set up to be active, not stranded with an empty balance.

chat_notif_nudge.prompt: Want a heads-up when @{peer} replies — even when this tab is closed?
chat_notif_nudge.enabled: Done — you'll be notified when a new message arrives.
chat_notif_nudge.privacy_note: Uses private browser notifications — no email or phone number, and you can turn them off anytime.

backup_keys_panel.warning_body: Anyone who has one of the private keys below can take full control of your account and your funds. Never share them with anyone — not Morphit, not support, not a friend, not any website. Store them somewhere only you can reach, like a password manager or paper kept somewhere safe.
backup_keys_panel.intro: These are the four keys for your account. Your 12 words are your Morphit backup; these keys let you use this same account in other Blurt apps like blurtwallet.com.

role_hint.owner: Full control of your account. Keep it offline.
role_hint.active: Moves funds and changes account settings.
role_hint.posting: Posts, votes, and signs in to Morphit.

backup_keys_panel.no_master_password: There is no master password. Morphit never creates or uses one — your 12 words and these keys are everything.
backup_keys_panel.txt_warning: KEEP THIS PRIVATE. Anyone who has a private key below can take full control of your account and funds. Never share it with anyone, never type it into a website you don't trust, and never send it in a message or email.
backup_keys_panel.txt_footer: Your 12-word seed phrase is your Morphit backup. These four keys let you use this account in other Blurt tools. There is no master password.

needs_account_name.body: You're signed in, but you don't have an account name yet. Add one to start trading and posting — until then you can browse.
